retrievalProfile.description: A gritty, high-contrast composition featuring central figures with a motorcycle, framed by heavy distressed vignettes and bold western-inspired typography.
triggerTerms: western slab serif typography with texture

recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic, low-angle shot of two men and a custom motorcycle in front of a weathered building, characterized by a dark, smoky vignette and high-contrast lighting that emphasizes metallic and leather textures.
coreVisualRelationships: The motorcycle acts as a diagonal bridge between the two subjects.
The top-heavy typography balances the dense visual weight of the motorcycle at the bottom.
The dark vignette focuses the viewer's eye on the central subjects and the bright text.
coreInvariants: Heavy, textured black vignette with red-tinted distressed edges.
High-contrast lighting on metallic surfaces and leather clothing.
A central mechanical element like a motorcycle or vehicle.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects flanking a central motorcycle; one seated, one standing, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized title text at the bottom and the blocky artist name at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular path starting from the top text, down the standing figure, across the motorcycle, and up through the seated figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with texture, subjects, and large-scale typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and shadows providing a gritty foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Desaturated earth tones and metallic silvers in the mid-ground.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Blood red highlights within the vignette and text outlines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark background and bright white/silver text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Western Slab Serif and Blackletter hybrid
letterConstructionRules: Heavy vertical strokes with sharp, exaggerated serifs.
Internal woodblock or metallic texture within the glyphs.
Thick white or silver outlines to separate text from dark backgrounds.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exaggerated descenders and ascenders on the primary title to create a framing effect.
Condensed, blocky proportions for the secondary artist name.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A blocky, architectural slab serif for the artist name paired with a fluid, aggressive decorative script for the title.

preserve: High contrast between text and background

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the rugged western slab serif feel for the top text.
Matches the distressed, decorative outlaw vibe for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty, high-contrast photo of two men with a custom motorcycle in front of a weathered shack, with a heavy black and red distressed vignette and smoky atmosphere.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, beveled white decorative title with a red glow at the bottom, and a blocky, textured silver slab-serif artist name at the top.

verificationChecks: Is the vignette sufficiently distressed and dark?
Does the motorcycle serve as a central visual anchor?
Is the typography legible despite the heavy textures?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red vignette tint
Amount of chrome reflection on the motorcycle
Level of distress on the typography
mustRedesign: Any clean or modern UI elements

mustAchieve: Gritty, weathered texture across all elements
Strong sense of depth through layering

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the vignette doesn't obscure the subjects' faces.
Verify the typography feels integrated into the gritty scene.
Confirm the red accents are used sparingly for impact.
recipe.reuseFormula: Gritty Photography + Western Slab Serif + Decorative Blackletter + Distressed Vignette = Outlaw Aesthetic
